name: Caricature Camera
source:
Okoda Electric Works, where the main character Shinobu Kamo works, goes bankrupt and closes due to a shortage of funds.

The president skips town overnight and the employees are at their wits’ end. Kamo, who spent his days in idleness, has no savings. He starts gambling as a last resort, which ends up giving him disappointing results as usual.

Kamo finally starts looking for a job, and luckily an offer of a part-time job comes his way.

The employer is…

Tokyo, Japan.
The population continues to grow year by year, with people settling in to fill the gaps, high-rise buildings line up, and people live and die in plots of only one square metre.

Nowadays, everyone is just another person in a crowd picture.

[Translated from [url=http://loveandes.com/camera/]the official website[/url].]
translation:
主角加茂忍所在的大田电工所因资金短缺而破产倒闭。

总统连夜出城，员工们束手无策。整天无所事事的加茂没有积蓄。他开始赌博作为最后的手段，但最终却像往常一样给他带来了令人失望的结果。

加茂终于开始找工作，幸运的是，他收到了一份兼职工作。

雇主是……

日本东京。
人口逐年增长，人们定居填补空缺，高楼林立，人们在仅仅一平方米的土地上生存和死亡。

如今，每个人都只是人群照片中的另一个人。

[翻译自[url=http://loveandes.com/camera/]官网[/url]。]
